name: GitHub: Self-Hosted Runners Can Intercept Broad-Token Jobs
query:
MATCH p=(runner:GH_Runner)-[:GH_CanInterceptJob]->(job:GH_WorkflowJob)
WHERE 'contents:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
OR 'actions:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
OR 'pull-requests:write' IN job.effective_github_token_permissions
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
description: Returns self-hosted runners that can intercept workflow jobs whose effective GITHUB_TOKEN has high-impact write permissions. These jobs can materially increase the blast radius of runner compromise.
